title: Cosmic Bear and Turtle Sage
description: A surreal psychedelic painting features an elderly man in a fedora and suit sitting on a large green sea turtle, pointing forward. Behind them looms a giant blue three-eyed bear with a glowing cosmic heart on its chest dripping purple, pink and green liquid. The background shows a black space scene with planets, stars, geometric patterns and small figures.
